user.title: What is being measured?
user.description: Pick the sensor reporting grid power. The sign matters: export must be negative. If yours is the other way round, tick the box.

data_description.grid_power: The meter at the grid connection, not the inverter.
data_description.grid_invert: Only tick this if your sensor reports export as positive.

wallbox.title: What does the controlling?
wallbox.description: The entity you use to set your charger's current. Anything that shows up in Home Assistant as a control works, whatever the brand.

data_description.switch_entity: Optional. Without it, only the current is controlled.
data_description.ev_power: Strongly recommended: without it there is no way to tell whether charging is happening at all.

confirm.title: Does this look right?

error.cannot_read_source: This entity is not returning a usable value right now.
error.not_a_current_control: This entity cannot do 6 A - it is probably not the charging current control.

abort.already_configured: This charger already has a control set up.

quellen.title: Further measurements
quellen.description: Solar power and home battery are needed for probing. Without them the integration only follows the export value.

data_description.battery_power: Charging must be positive, discharging negative.

data.surplus_includes_ev: Charger sits behind the grid meter

data_description.surplus_includes_ev: Only tick this if charging lowers the measured export. Set wrongly, the control feeds back on itself.
data_description.respect_manual: If someone sets the current by hand, the control rests for ten minutes.
data_description.switch_entity: Needed if the current control cannot go to 0 - otherwise the charger keeps going at its minimum current during every pause.

phasen.title: Phase switching
phasen.description: On three phases, 6 A is already 4.1 kW - on weak days a three-phase charger will not charge at all. If yours can switch, pick the entity here. The switch for it is off by default.

data_description.phase_currents: Used to detect how many phases the car actually draws.

fahrzeug.title: Vehicle
fahrzeug.description: Only for the "Min + solar" mode: if the car is nearly empty, it tops up from the grid.
